events.title: Dinamo Samarqand vs Xorazm
events.dataContent:
Dinamo Samarqand vs Xorazm: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of a crucial match in the Uzbekistan Super League relegation battle, as Dinamo Samarqand hosts Xorazm. This is a confrontation between two underdogs occupying the bottom spots of the league table. A defeat in this encounter could be fatal for either team in their fight to stay in the top flight.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 13:30 UTC (16:30 MSK)
Stadium: Dinamo Samarkand Stadium, Samarkand
Competition: Uzbekistan Super League

Dinamo Samarqand vs Xorazm: Match Preview

This is a classic 'six-pointer' between two teams from the bottom of the table. Dinamo and Xorazm are the main candidates for relegation, showing extremely poor results throughout the season. They are familiar rivals from last season's Pro League. The head-to-head history suggests a competitive rivalry where neither team has a clear advantage: in the last five games, Dinamo has two wins, Xorazm has two, and one match ended in a draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Dinamo Samarqand

The Samarkand club is having a disastrous season after returning to the top flight. The team has one of the worst defenses in the league and scores very few goals. The only hope for the hosts is their home-field advantage and the support of their fans. In their last home meeting against Xorazm last season, Dinamo secured a convincing 3-0 victory.

Xorazm

Xorazm, also promoted from the Pro League, has failed to adapt to the realities of the Super League. The team has lost most of its matches, with away games being particularly difficult. Like their opponent today, Xorazm has huge problems in both defense and attack. The team will aim to play as cautiously as possible to take at least one point from Samarkand.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Dinamo Samarqand (4-4-2): Meliev; Abdurakhmonov, Khakimov, Sharipov, Najmiddinov; Ibragimov, Rashidkhanov, Safarov, Emmanuel; Sayfiev, Abdumalikov.
  • Xorazm (5-4-1): Khamroev; Mukhammadiev, Sadikov, Odilov, Karimov, Islomov; Juraev, Iskandarov, Sobirkhujaev, Akhmedov; Kenjaev.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A tense and nervous game between the league's two weakest teams is expected. In a match with such high stakes, character and dedication, rather than skill, will come to the forefront. Dinamo has a slight advantage due to playing at home.

  • Main Prediction: Dinamo Samarqand Double Chance (1X). In a home match against a direct relegation rival, the Samarkand team simply cannot afford to lose.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Both teams have colossal problems in attack, and the cost of a mistake will be extremely high, which points to a low-scoring game.

events.title: Navbahor vs Nasaf
events.dataContent:
Navbahor vs Nasaf: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the central match of the round, and arguably the entire second half of the Uzbekistan Super League season. At the Markaziy Stadium in Namangan, local side Navbahor hosts the league leaders and their main rival for the gold medals, Nasaf Qarshi. This is a battle between the country's two best teams, the outcome of which could directly impact the fate of the championship title.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 13:30 UTC (16:30 MSK)
Stadium: Markaziy Stadium, Namangan
Competition: Uzbekistan Super League

Navbahor vs Nasaf: Match Preview

Both teams come into this 'golden match' in excellent form, occupying the top two spots in the league table. Navbahor is traditionally strong on their home turf with fervent fan support and will be looking to close the gap on the leader. Nasaf is having an outstanding season, boasting the best defense in the league and a long unbeaten streak. Encounters between these rivals are always tense, tactical battles with a minimum of scoring chances. The first-round match ended in a goalless draw, which only confirms the teams' equal strength.

Team Form and Analysis

Navbahor

The 'Falcons,' under the management of Samvel Babayan, rely on a solid defense and quick wing attacks. The team is undefeated at home this season and will be highly motivated to avenge last season's missed championship opportunity. The attack is led by Oston Urunov and Georgian legionnaire Toma Tabatadze.

Nasaf

The 'Dragons,' under the long-standing leadership of Ruziqul Berdiev, play the most stable and organized football in the country. The team concedes very few goals and is highly efficient with their chances. Nasaf is unbeaten in their last 15 league matches and will aim to at least avoid defeat in Namangan to maintain a comfortable lead in the title race.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Navbahor (4-2-3-1): Yusupov; Sayfiev, Milović, Ivanović, Yuldoshev; Ismoilov, Boltaboev; Iskandarov, Urunov, Sobirjonov; Tabatadze.
  • Nasaf (4-3-3): Nematov; Nasrullaev, Davronov, Eshmurodov, G'aybullaev; Muhitdinov, Bozorov, Stanojević; Norchaev, Mateus, Mozgovoy.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A classic confrontation between the league's two best defenses is expected. The game will likely be decided by the first mistake, with a lot of tactical battling and minimal risk-taking from both sides.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. In a battle between two evenly matched leaders where the cost of defeat is extremely high, a draw seems the most likely outcome, as it has been in 4 of the last 7 head-to-head meetings.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Matches between Navbahor and Nasaf are historically low-scoring, and this decisive meeting is unlikely to be an exception.

events.title: Ufa vs Neftekhimik
events.dataContent:
Ufa vs Neftekhimik: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Russian Cup match, where FC Ufa hosts Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk at the Neftyanik Stadium. This is a clash between two familiar rivals from the First League, for whom the cup competition is an opportunity to make a statement and advance as far as possible.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 14:00 UTC (17:00 MSK)
Stadium: Neftyanik Stadium, Ufa
Competition: Russian Cup

Ufa vs Neftekhimik: Match Preview

This is a meeting of two teams of a roughly equal level, which promises a tight and uncompromising battle. Ufa, with its experience in the Premier League, is considered a slight favorite due to the home-field advantage. Neftekhimik is known for its resilient character and disciplined defense. The head-to-head history confirms the evenly matched nature of this fixture: in the last six meetings, each team has won once, with four matches ending in a draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Ufa

The Ufa team is aiming to return to the top flight of Russian football, and home matches are key for them to gain points and confidence. The team focuses on ball control and wing play. In a home cup match in front of their fans, Ufa will aim to dictate the play and score an early goal to break down the opponent's organized defense.

Neftekhimik

The team from Nizhnekamsk is a classic solid mid-table side in the First League. Neftekhimik emphasizes tactical discipline and defensive reliability. In an away cup match, the team is likely to adopt a deep defensive formation, relying on set pieces and rare, swift counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Ufa (4-2-3-1): Chernov; Ten, Kutin, Botaka, Golubev; Pasevich, Troyanov; Minaev, Ortiz, Ageyan; Molteninov.
  • Neftekhimik (5-3-2): Golubev; Berdnikov, Gerasimov, Shorkin, Kotov, Denisov; Dvoretskov, Kanaev, Emelyanov; Kokoev, Bazelyuk.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A typical cup match between two evenly matched teams from the same division is expected. The stakes will be high, so the game is unlikely to be an open affair. The home advantage gives Ufa a slight edge.

  • Main Prediction: Ufa Double Chance (1X). On their home turf, Ufa should at least avoid defeat in regular time, especially given the high number of draws in their head-to-head history.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Matches between these rivals, like most knockout cup games, are rarely high-scoring, a trend confirmed by statistics.

Fakel vs Arsenal Tula: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Russian Cup match, in which Fakel Voronezh hosts Arsenal Tula at their home ground. This is a clash between a Premier League representative and one of the leaders of the First League, where the hosts are considered favorites due to their higher status and home-stadium advantage.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 16:30 UTC (19:30 MSK)
Stadium: Tsentralnyi Profsoyuz Stadion, Voronezh
Competition: Russian Cup

Fakel vs Arsenal Tula: Match Preview

Fakel approaches this cup match aiming to please their fans, who create one of the most intense atmospheres in Russian football. For the Voronezh team, the Cup is a good opportunity to prove themselves. Arsenal Tula, fighting for a return to the RPL, is a solid and organized team. Matches between these teams are typically tight, physical contests with a low number of goals, and their last head-to-head meeting ended in a 1-1 draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Fakel

The team from Voronezh relies on athletic, physical football and set pieces. At home, with the incredible support of the crowd, Fakel plays with doubled energy. The coaching staff is expected to rotate the squad partially, giving a chance to backup players, but even with this lineup, Fakel will be a formidable force.

Arsenal Tula

The 'Gunners' from Tula are an experienced and tactically astute team. In an away cup match against an RPL representative, Arsenal will likely focus on a tight defensive game and quick counter-attacks. The visitors will aim to impose a gritty midfield battle and capitalize on their chances from set pieces.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Fakel (5-3-2): Belenov; Magal, Yurganov, Senhadji, Bryzgalov, Cherov; Alshin, Kvekveskiri, Mendel; Markov, Appaev.
  • Arsenal Tula (4-2-3-1): Kokarev; Botaka, Bolshakov, Denisov, Pomerko; Makarov, Kaynov; Tkachuk, Manuylov, Levin; Joku.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Fakel is the favorite due to their home-field advantage and RPL status. However, Arsenal is a tough nut to crack, and it won't be an easy ride for the hosts, especially given the history of drawn matches between them.

  • Main Prediction: Fakel to Qualify. The Voronezh side should advance to the next round based on class and home support, though perhaps not in regular time.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Knockout cup matches, especially between these teams, are rarely high-scoring, a fact supported by their head-to-head statistics.

Al-Ahli vs Al Riyadh: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Saudi Pro League match, in which one of the giants and championship contenders, Al-Ahli from Jeddah, hosts Al Riyadh. This is a confrontation between a team with sky-high ambitions and a star-studded squad against a modest side whose main goal is to stay in the top flight.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK)
Stadium: Prince Abdullah al-Faisal Stadium, Jeddah
Competition: Saudi Pro League

Al-Ahli vs Al Riyadh: Match Preview

Al-Ahli enters the match as the undisputed favorite. The team is in the leading group and demonstrates powerful attacking football, especially on their home turf. Al Riyadh, in turn, is located in the lower part of the league table and experiences serious difficulties in matches against top clubs. The head-to-head history is also entirely on the side of Al-Ahli, who have won the majority of recent encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Al-Ahli

Al-Ahli's star-studded squad allows the team to dominate most of their matches. The attacking line, featuring Riyad Mahrez, Roberto Firmino, Allan Saint-Maximin, and Gabri Veiga, is one of the strongest in the league. In home games, Al-Ahli plays from a position of strength, controlling possession and putting constant pressure on the opponent's defense. The team will be looking for a convincing victory to continue their title chase.

Al Riyadh

The capital's club is in a desperate fight for survival. The team relies on organized defense and commitment. In an away match against one of the giants, Al Riyadh will undoubtedly opt for a deep defensive strategy, hoping for rare counter-attacks and set pieces. Containing the hosts' formidable attack will be an extremely difficult task for them.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al-Ahli (4-2-3-1): Mendy; Majrashi, Demiral, Ibañez, Balobaid; Kessié, Al-Johani; Mahrez, Veiga, Saint-Maximin; Firmino.
  • Al Riyadh (5-4-1): Campaña; Al-Shuwayyi, Al-Shwirekh, Asiri, Toșca, Al-Khaibari; Al-Zaqan, Touré, Ndong, Al-Shehri; Gray.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The difference in class between the two teams is colossal. Al-Ahli, on their home ground, should have no problems dealing with one of the league's underdogs.

  • Main Prediction: Al-Ahli to Win with a (-2) Handicap. The hosts' star-studded attack should ensure a victory margin of at least two or three goals.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.0 Goals. Al-Ahli scores a lot, especially at home, and Al Riyadh is unlikely to keep a clean sheet.

Cagliari vs Sassuolo: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Italian Serie A match, where Cagliari hosts Sassuolo at the Unipol Domus stadium. This is a clash between two neighbors from the bottom half of the table, separated by just one point, with both teams looking to end their winless streaks.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK)
Stadium: Unipol Domus, Cagliari
Competition: Serie A

Cagliari vs Sassuolo: Match Preview

Cagliari comes into the match in 14th place in the table. The team is winless in their last four rounds, but showed character in their last game, coming back from 2-0 down to draw 2-2 away at Verona. Sassuolo, who returned to Serie A this season, sits in 13th place. In the last round, the Neroverdi lost 1-0 to Roma, which ended their three-match unbeaten run. The head-to-head history favors Cagliari: the Sardinians have won the last three encounters and have lost to Sassuolo only once in the last nine meetings.

Team Form and Analysis

Cagliari

The 'Islanders' have been struggling recently, losing their last two home matches by a combined score of 4-0. The team rarely keeps clean sheets, having managed only one in the league this season. The hosts have significant personnel problems: Andrea Belotti and Alessandro Di Pardo will miss the match due to injury, while the participation of Yerry Mina and Alessandro Deiola is in doubt.

Sassuolo

Despite being a newly-promoted side, Sassuolo has proven to be a solid team, especially in defense, having conceded only 9 goals this season – the second-best record among teams in the bottom half of the table. However, the team does not play as confidently on the road, having won only one of their last nine away games against Cagliari. The visitors will also have to do without several key players due to injuries.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Cagliari (3-5-2): Caprile; Zappa, Zé Pedro, Idrissi; Palestra, Liteta, Prati, Folorunsho, Obert; Borrelli, Gaetano.
  • Sassuolo (4-2-3-1): Consigli; Toljan, Erlić, Ferrari, Viti; Račić, Thorstvedt; Berardi, Bajrami, Laurienté; Pinamonti.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A tight contest is expected between two evenly matched teams. Cagliari has the advantage in head-to-head meetings and is playing at home, but their current form is a cause for concern. Sassuolo is better organized defensively.

  • Main Prediction: Under 2.5 goals. Sassuolo's last three Serie A games have stayed under this total, and Cagliari has been struggling to score at home.
  • Result Prediction: Draw. Considering the problems both teams are facing and their desire not to lose to a direct competitor, a draw seems a very likely outcome.

Puerto de Vega vs Celta de Vigo: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of one of the most exciting matches of the first round of the Spanish Copa del Rey, where the modest amateur club Puerto de Vega from Asturias hosts La Liga representative, Celta de Vigo. This is a true cup fairytale, where a team from a regional league gets the chance to compete against top-level professionals.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 18:00 UTC (21:00 MSK)
Stadium: El Monte, Puerto de Vega
Competition: Copa del Rey, 1st Round

Puerto de Vega vs Celta de Vigo: Match Preview

For Puerto de Vega and the entire town, this match is a historic event, a celebration of football. Players who have day jobs will take to the field against La Liga stars. The hosts' motivation will be off the charts. Celta, in turn, comes into the match as the absolute favorite. It is expected that coach Claudio Giráldez will completely rotate his squad, giving a chance to reserves, youth team players, and those who get little playing time in the league.

Team Form and Analysis

Puerto de Vega

The amateur club from Asturias has made it to this stage by navigating the qualifying rounds and showing incredible character. Against Celta, the team will rely on supreme dedication, the strictest defensive discipline, and a bit of luck. Every corner or free-kick near the visitors' goal will be a chance for them to create a miracle, backed by the passionate support of the local fans.

Celta de Vigo

The 'Celts' will be looking to avoid any underestimation of their opponent and decide the outcome of the match as quickly as possible. Even a fully rotated Celta squad is vastly superior in class and physical condition to any of the home team's players. For the Celta players who take the field, this will be an excellent opportunity to prove their worth to the coach and stake their claim for a place in the starting lineup. Total domination by the visitors in all aspects of the game is expected.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Puerto de Vega (5-4-1): Rodríguez; Fernández, González, Álvarez, Suárez, Pérez; García, Martínez, López, Díaz; Iglesias.
  • Celta de Vigo (4-3-3): Marchesín; Carreira, Domínguez, Rodríguez, Ristić; Sotelo, Veiga, de la Torre; Carles Pérez, Paciência, Swedberg.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite all the magic and romance of the cup, the difference in class between a professional La Liga club and an amateur team from a regional division is colossal. Celta should secure a very comfortable victory.

  • Main Prediction: Celta de Vigo to Win with a (-3) Handicap. Even a reserve Celta squad should have no trouble routing an amateur side.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. Celta will surely score many goals, and the home team, spurred on by emotion and crowd support, might just manage a historic consolation goal.

Pisa vs Lazio: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Italian Serie A Matchday 9 fixture, as Pisa hosts Lazio at the Arena Garibaldi. This is a clash between a team fighting for survival and a giant that has yet to live up to expectations this season.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK)
Stadium: Arena Garibaldi, Pisa
Competition: Serie A, Matchday 9

Pisa vs Lazio: Match Preview

Pisa comes into the match still searching for their first Serie A victory since their return. In the last round, the team was on the verge of a historic success but let a win slip away against AC Milan (2-2). That result, however, ended Pisa's goalless streak and showed they can compete with Italy's best. Lazio, meanwhile, sitting in mid-table, has struggled for consistency despite a four-match unbeaten run in the league (W2, D2). The teams have not met since 1991, when Lazio secured a minimal 1-0 victory.

Team Form and Analysis

Pisa

Alberto Gilardino's side is facing huge problems in attack, especially in home games, where they have yet to score this season (D2, L2). Pisa had scored the fewest goals in the league heading into the round and concedes an average of 1.5 goals per game. Despite this, their home defense has been relatively solid, conceding only twice in four matches.

Lazio

The Romans, under Maurizio Sarri, have had a poor start, collecting just 11 points, one of their worst starts in the last 12 seasons. The 'Eagles' have struggled on the road, with only one win in their last five away league games. However, the team secured an important 1-0 victory over Juventus in the last round. Lazio has injury concerns, with Toma Bašić and Elseid Hysaj likely to miss out.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Pisa (4-2-3-1): Semper; Cuadrado, Caracciolo, Angori, Barbieri; Marin, Veloso; Arena, D'Alessandro, Nzola; Bonazzoli.
  • Lazio (4-3-3): Provedel; Lazzari, Casale, Romagnoli, Pellegrini; Guendouzi, Cataldi, Luis Alberto; Felipe Anderson, Castellanos, Zaccagni.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Lazio is the favorite, despite their recent problems and unconvincing away form. The quality of their players should make the difference. However, Pisa showed their teeth against AC Milan and will fight desperately for points at home.

  • Main Prediction: Lazio to Win. The Romans need to pick up points to climb the table, and a match against an underdog is the best opportunity to do so.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Pisa doesn't score at home, and Lazio has generally been a low-scoring team this season.

Palma del Rio vs Real Betis: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this first-round Spanish Copa del Rey match, where the modest amateur club Atlético Palma del Río hosts one of the giants of La Liga and a regular in European competitions, Real Betis from Seville. 1 This is a classic 'David vs. Goliath' cup story, where the match itself is a historic achievement for the hosts. 2

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK)
Stadium: El Pandero, Palma del Río
Competition: Copa del Rey, 1st Round

Palma del Rio vs Real Betis: Match Preview

For Palma del Río, a team from the regional league of Andalusia, this match is the biggest in the club's history. The town and the team are buzzing with anticipation for the arrival of their star-studded neighbors from Seville. The motivation of the amateur players will be immense. Real Betis, on the other hand, is the absolute favorite. It is expected that coach Manuel Pellegrini will completely rotate his squad, giving playing time to reserves and young talents from the academy to rest his key players for La Liga and Europa League matches. 3

Team Form and Analysis

Atlético Palma del Río

The hosts have made it to this stage by navigating through the qualifying rounds. The team, composed of semi-professionals and amateurs, will rely on incredible dedication, the strictest defensive discipline, and the support of their home crowd.
